verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Qodo reviews pull requests automatically and lets users control when reviews run (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-26). Nothing documents an incremental re-review triggered by new commits, tracking which earlier findings were fixed, or avoiding repeated old comments. The findings-history and resolve-findings mentions are adjacent governance and agent features, not incremental PR re-review.

support.subject: As a developer, pushing new commits triggers an incremental re-review that tracks what was fixed instead of repeating old comments
